case.description: Balanced(c,x,y) is the LEAST relation containing supplied epsilon pairs in context c, closed under concatenation and matching opening(x,a,k), balanced(c,a,b), closing(b,y,k). Both wrapping edges must not be denied in c. Opening and closing labels must match; denial is scoped to the exact context and edge. Cycles require a fixed point. needs(job,c,x,y,d,u,v) asks for those two paths. bridge(z,y) is an ordinary directed edge, not a balanced segment.
goals: Return every non-excluded job for which BOTH requested balanced paths exist.
Select all eligible jobs with a balanced first request and a balanced second request, each in its own context. Omit excluded jobs. This is the same intent expressed differently.

After the source update, return every non-excluded job for which SOME balanced segment from x to z in context c is followed by bridge(z,y), AND the second requested balanced path exists. Recheck old support.

baseline-balanced.endpoint: Entire three-stage task: all calls through first independently correct answer for every stage, including source update and repairs.
baseline-balanced.interpretation: Fresh and retained expose identical domain checks from round one; source-only exposes ground source checks. No model query synthesis.

case.description: flow and permit are mutually recursive LEAST relations. start(node,tag) seeds flow, permission(node,tag) seeds permit. A flow(x,t) and grant(x,y,t) give permit(y,t) when blocked(y,t) is absent. A flow(x,t), edge(x,y), and permit(y,t) give flow(y,t) when blocked(y,t) is absent. A flow(x,t) and convert(x,t,u) give flow(x,u) when blocked(x,u) is absent. Blocking is tag-specific; start and permission seeds are unconditional. needs(job,x,t,y,u,z,v,w,q) requires all four flow facts.
goals: Return every non-excluded job whose FOUR requested flow facts all hold.
Return the complete set of eligible jobs for which each of the four listed node/tag states is reachable by flow. Exclude the excluded jobs. This repeats the same intent.
After the source update, return every non-excluded job whose FOUR requested flow facts all hold. Recheck old support.
